Message: a dynamic: runtime query that picks its own rows, by LIMIT, OFFSET, FETCH, DISTINCT ON or a clause such as QUALIFY, is read from a derived table by its output names, so each output column needs a name no other has; give the columns distinct aliases

a dynamic: runtime query returns rows other than those it reads, through GROUP BY, HAVING, DISTINCT, an aggregate, window or set-returning function, its own LIMIT, or a compound; .Count(ctx) wraps the original in a subquery so the count reflects outer-result rows rather than the underlying table
